messages:
luis_solutions: Heads-up: GreenRiver Health asked for a weekend POC (Sat-Sun) + capability matrix comparing us vs CloudCorp and InfraAI. Need to confirm pricing breakpoints and whether we can present HSM/KMS certs. Spreadsheet draft: https://drive.redwood/g/GR-poc-cap-matrix (view-only).
amy_sales: Thanks Luis. Can we scope the minimal dataset and test plan? They need PHI-residency in eu-west-1.
devon_se: We can run a stripped-down eval on dedicated nodes. Two blockers: (1) HSM-backed keywrap — we have KMS integration but HSM attestations timeline? (2) On-prem image for private deploy — needs legal signoff. @maya_security any updates?
maya_security: HSM attestation: engineering finished integration but the vendor's FIPS/HSM cert copies are with compliance. I can attach the certs. Also SOC2 report pdf available. I'll DM legal for on-prem NDA flag. Attaching: /files/soc2_2025.pdf | /files/hsm_certs.zip
sarah_pricing: Pricing question: for a 48-hour weekend POC, do we offer a free short POC or discounted reserved capacity rate? For enterprise, we usually do 50% off for <1 week trials, or propose a $X/day reserved test rate. Anyone have a competitor-rate benchmark?
amy_sales: CloudCorp typically gives free but with lead gen. InfraAI charges $1200/day for dedicated GPU. We should offer 2 free dev seats + 50% off reserved nodes for weekend.
devon_se: Operational notes: provision template below. Need region eu-west-1 nodes + model pinned to rdx-4b-quant. Command to create canary fleet: ```redwoodctl create-fleet --tier=dedicated --region=eu-west-1 --nodes=2 --image=rdx-private:v2``` Will take ~3hrs to provision.
luis_solutions: Good — can we commit to provisioning by Friday EOD? I'll handle the customer comms. @sarah_pricing, confirm the invoice language and we need an SLA snippet for the POC:
sarah_pricing: SLA snippet (proposed): ```POC SLA: Redwood will aim for 99% availability of provisioned nodes during POC window. No penalties for trial. Support: email + priority Slack channel.```
maya_security: Customer asked for data residency write-up and KMS flow diagram. I'll paste a short blurb they can include in RFI
maya_security: Data residency blurb: 'Redwood can be provisioned in customer-specific cloud regions. Data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMK) via KMS/HSM; logs and metrics can be retained in customer-controlled buckets. We support VPC peering and private endpoints for full network isolation.'
amy_sales: :thumbsup: I'll update the capability matrix with the HSM/cert and SLA row. @devon_se can you attach expected provision timeline? Also need legal to sign the standard POC MSA — @legal-bot any blockers?
ops_bot: legal-bot hasn't responded. I've created ticket RLW-482 to route the MSA to legal; ETA 48 hours.
devon_se: Provision timeline: Friday EOD kickoff -> nodes up by Sat 03:00 UTC -> model & dataset ingest by Sat 09:00 UTC -> validation tests Sat 12:00-18:00 UTC. I'll be on call Sat morning.
luis_solutions: Perfect. I'll send candidate email to GreenRiver with proposed times and the updated spreadsheet. Thanks team :rocket:
